title: Sloppy construction
text: Sloppy construction. Many issues: Ribbons not pulled taut and stick out in loops hanging. Won't wash well at all. I planned to take off pearls etc but construction is such you can see how bad its made even through the rod pockets. Ragged edges show up in sunlight. Don't buy.
